name: Monthly Money Check-in
description: Bookkeeping education for the end of the month: how to read what came in and what went out, where Iker shows it (the Business report and the statement of accounts), and one thing to decide from it. Includes a vertical cut.

scenes.title: Month end
scenes.guidance: The last day of the month, told as it happens: money came in different ways, costs sit in a notebook, and the owner cannot say whether the month made money. No statistics.

lines.text: The question the owner cannot answer

scenes.title: Three numbers
scenes.guidance: Teach first: what came in, what went out, and what was left. Plain words, no jargon such as ledger or reconciliation.

visual.heading: Read the month in three numbers

scenes.title: A made-up month
scenes.guidance: One fictional business's month as a worked example. Every figure is made up and the narration says so. Never present the numbers as a real business or as an Iker result.

visual.heading: A made-up month
visual.source: Made-up example figures, not real data

scenes.title: Chapter card
scenes.guidance: Leave empty: this is a silent chapter card.

scenes.title: The Business report
scenes.guidance: Open Report under Accounting and name what the Business report shows, using the product's labels. Say the footage uses made-up data.

scenes.title: Confirm before you read
scenes.guidance: Payments waiting for the owner's confirmation are not counted as income yet. Say why that matters before reading the month.

visual.headline: Confirm first, then read the month

scenes.title: The statement of accounts
scenes.guidance: Show Transactions: every payment, refund and expense in one list. Name the statement of accounts as the product does.

scenes.title: One thing to decide
scenes.guidance: Turn the numbers into one decision for next month. This is advice, not a product promise. Add 'depending on your plan' for expense entries.

scenes.title: What you have now
scenes.guidance: Answer the hook's question with what the owner now has. No promised profit, no unsupported numbers.

scenes.title: Next step
scenes.guidance: One next step, using the site's own call to action. Teach first; this is not an advert.

scenes.title: Outro
scenes.guidance: Leave empty: brand outro without narration.

scenes.title: Hook
scenes.guidance: The month-end question in one or two sentences.

scenes.title: Three numbers
scenes.guidance: What came in, what went out, what was left, on made-up figures the narration calls examples.

visual.heading: A made-up month
visual.source: Made-up example figures, not real data

scenes.title: In Iker
scenes.guidance: One screen of the Business report. Say it is made-up data.

scenes.title: One decision
scenes.guidance: The one thing to decide for next month, in one line.
